verdict.rationale: FireHydrant has an API reference page (firehydrant-docs-21) but there is no evidence of an interactive, runnable-example explorer; probes for openapi/swagger specs all returned 404 (firehydrant-probe-2), and no docs mention 'try it' or code-execution features. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API console, runnable code samples, or a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec.
